token.description: The value of the environment variable the node's `token_env` names.

info.description: Turns a batch of texts into the vectors Mash indexes. Mash reaches a worker with `[embeddings] backend = "remote"`; search queries are always embedded locally. Bodies are versioned binary frames with little-endian integers. Generated from crates/mash-search/src/semantic/remote.rs; do not edit.
info.title: mash-embedding-worker

post.description: One attempt per batch: the client never retries and never switches to local inference, because a failed or timed-out request may still have been billed. The worker refuses a recipe other than its own, so its vectors are interchangeable with ones Mash computed locally. Up to four requests may be in flight; the worker runs inference for one at a time.

parameters.description: Present when the body is a zstd-compressed frame. Clients compress frames of one kilobyte or more. The decompressed frame has the same byte limit as a plain one.
parameters.name: Content-Encoding

requestBody.description: Request frame, in order: the 4-byte magic `MSH1`; u16 recipe length and the recipe as UTF-8; a 32-byte request ID chosen by the client; u32 input count, at least one; then for each input a u32 ID, a u32 length and the text as UTF-8. Input IDs are unique and cover 0 to count-1. The texts together stay within the input byte limit. Nothing follows the last input.

200.description: Reply frame, in order: the 4-byte magic `MSR1`; the request's 32-byte ID; u32 inference time in milliseconds; u32 vector count; then for each input a u32 ID and its vector as one f16 per dimension. Vectors are mean-pooled over the attention mask and L2-normalized, one per input.

400.description: The frame is malformed, exceeds a limit or names another recipe. The message never contains input text.

401.description: The bearer token is missing or wrong.

413.description: The body exceeds the byte limit.

415.description: The content encoding is not zstd.

500.description: The model failed or produced a vector outside the contract.
